mapper.select: SELECT pr.result_id, pr.entry_id, pr.user_id, pr.item_id, pr.score, pr.rank, pr.create_time FROM personal_result AS pr WHERE pr.item_id = #{itemId} AND pr.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY pr.score DESC
